worker_report.summary: Implemented Unity Input System backend with OwnerNetworkTransform owner controller and grounded CharacterController movement. Created CoopPlayerMotor.cs synthesizing WASD + mouse look input, sprint modifier, jump on space, escape cursor unlock. Added PlayerMovementSettings ScriptableObject asset for unified tuning of speed/height/gravity/sensitivity. Wrote NetworkPlayer.prefab with NetworkObject, OwnerNetworkTransform, CharacterController, Camera, AudioListener, and CoopPlayerMotor components wired. Created PlayerInput.inputactions action map defining all bindings (WASD, shift sprint, space jump, mouse look). Code follows existing prototype patterns for co-op horror scene networked movement.
